description.zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文。
- **en**：英文。
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.
- **en**: English.

description.zh: 处置任务的查询结束时间，格式：13位的时间戳。
description.en: The end time of the query for response tasks. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

description.zh: 处置任务的查询开始时间，格式：13位的时间戳。
description.en: The start time of the query for response tasks. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view.

description.zh:
视图类型。取值：

- 0（默认）：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type. Valid values:

- 0 (default): the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise.

title.zh: 获取处置任务的统计信息

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解响应编排产品（即威胁分析与响应日志接入流量）的收费方式和[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/sas/detail/sas)。
descriptions.en: Make sure that you fully understand the billing method and [pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/sas/detail/sas) of the response orchestration product (Cloud Threat Detection and Response (CTDR) log traffic) before you call this operation.
